audit_status.source_base: Hebrew source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft translation of 2 Chronicles 6 grounded in supplied Hebrew; YHWH rendered as requested. Preserve prayer structure, temple‑petition sequence, and measurement detail. Several liturgical markers ({פ},{ס}) and metric/phrase variants flagged for witness review.

verses.restored: Then Solomon said, YHWH said that he would dwell in the thick darkness (arafel).

familiar.text: Then said Solomon, The LORD hath said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

modern.text: Then Solomon declared: “The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud;

original.text: אָ֖ז אָמַ֣ר שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה יְהוָ֣ה אָמַ֔ר לִשְׁכּ֖וֹן בָּעֲרָפֶֽל

verses.restored: But I have built a house of habitation for you, and a place for your dwelling for ever.

familiar.text: But I have built an house of habitation for thee, and a place for thy dwelling for ever.

modern.text: and I have built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.”

original.text: וַֽאֲנִ֛י בָּנִ֥יתִי בֵית זְבֻ֖ל לָ֑ךְ וּמָכ֥וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֖ עוֹלָמִֽים

verses.restored: And the king turned his face and blessed the whole assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.

familiar.text: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Israel: and all the congregation of Israel stood.

modern.text: And as the whole assembly of Israel stood there, the king turned around and blessed them all

original.text: וַיַּסֵּ֤ב הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֶת פָּנָ֔יו וַיְבָ֕רֶךְ אֵ֖ת כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכָל קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עוֹמֵֽד

verses.restored: And he said, Blessed be YHWH, the God of Israel, who with his hands has fulfilled that which he spoke by mouth to my father David, saying,

familiar.text: And he said, Blessed be the LORD God of Israel, who hath with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

modern.text: and said: “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,

original.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר בְּפִ֔יו אֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י וּבְיָדָ֥יו מִלֵּ֖א לֵאמֹֽר

verses.restored: Since the day that I brought forth my people from the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build a house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be ruler over my people Israel.

familiar.text: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Israel to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Israel:

modern.text: ‘Since the day I brought My people out of the land of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there, nor have I chosen anyone to be ruler over My people Israel.

original.text: מִן הַיּ֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֣אתִי אֶת עַמִּי֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ לֹא בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְעִ֗יר מִכֹּל֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לִהְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם וְלֹא בָחַ֣רְתִּֽי בְאִ֔ישׁ לִהְי֥וֹת נָגִ֖יד עַל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: But I have chosen Jerusalem to be the place for my name, and I have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

familiar.text: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Israel.

modern.text: But now I have chosen Jerusalem for My Name to be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’

original.text: וָאֶבְחַר֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לִהְי֥וֹת שְׁמִ֖י שָׁ֑ם וָאֶבְחַ֣ר בְּדָוִ֔יד לִהְי֖וֹת עַל עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And with the heart of David my father it was to build a house for the name of YHWH, the God of Israel.

familiar.text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

modern.text: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

original.text: וַיְהִ֕י עִם לְבַ֖ב דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֑י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: But YHWH said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you have done well that it was in your heart.

familiar.text: But the LORD said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in thine heart to build an house for my name, thou didst well in that it was in thine heart:

modern.text: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.

original.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיָה֙ עִם לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ לִבְנ֥וֹת בַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִ֑י הֱֽטִיב֔וֹתָ כִּ֥י הָיָ֖ה עִם לְבָבֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Yet you shall not build the house; but your son who shall come forth from your loins shall build the house for my name.

familiar.text: Notwithstanding thou shalt not build the house; but thy son which shall come forth out of thy loins, he shall build the house for my name.

modern.text: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’

original.text: רַ֣ק אַתָּ֔ה לֹ֥א תִבְנֶ֖ה הַבָּ֑יִת כִּ֤י בִנְךָ֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֣א מֵֽחֲלָצֶ֔יךָ הֽוּא יִבְנֶ֥ה הַבַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִֽי

verses.restored: And YHWH has established his word which he spoke, and I have risen up in the place of David my father and sat on the throne of Israel, as YHWH spoke, and have built the house for the name of YHWH, the God of Israel.

familiar.text: The LORD therefore hath performed his word that he hath spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised, and have built the house for the name of the LORD God of Israel.

modern.text: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke. I have succeeded my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.

original.text: וַיָּ֣קֶם יְהוָ֔ה אֶת דְּבָר֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּ֑ר וָאָק֡וּם תַּחַת֩ דָּוִ֨יד אָבִ֜י וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וָאֶבְנֶ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And there I have placed the ark in which is the covenant of YHWH that he cut with the children of Israel.

familiar.text: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of the LORD, that he made with the children of Israel.

modern.text: And there I have provided a place for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with the children of Israel.” Solomon’s Prayer of Dedication (1 Kings 8:22–53)

original.text: וָאָשִׂ֥ים שָׁם֙ אֶת הָ֣אָר֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר שָׁ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: And he stood before the altar of YHWH in the presence of all Israel, and spread forth his hands.

familiar.text: And he stood before the altar of the LORD in the presence of all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands:

modern.text: Then Solomon stood before the altar of the LORD in front of the whole assembly of Israel and spread out his hands.

original.text: וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד לִפְנֵי֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה נֶ֖גֶד כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּפְרֹ֖שׂ כַּפָּֽיו

verses.restored: For Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits broad, and three cubits high; and he set it in the midst of the court; and upon it he stood and spread forth his hands toward heaven before all Israel.

familiar.text: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Israel, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

notes.title: short
notes.body: Measurements: five × five × three cubits (Heb. אַמּוֹת); platform (כִּיּוֹר נְחֹשֶׁת) rendered 'bronze platform'.

modern.text: Now Solomon had made a bronze platform five cubits long, five cubits wide, and three cubits high, and had placed it in the middle of the courtyard. He stood on it, knelt down before the whole assembly of Israel, spread out his hands toward heaven,

original.text: כִּֽי עָשָׂ֨ה שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה כִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֗שֶׁת וַֽיִּתְּנֵהוּ֮ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעֲזָרָה֒ חָמֵ֨שׁ אַמּ֜וֹת אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְחָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמּ֥וֹת שָׁל֖וֹשׁ קוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד עָלָ֗יו וַיִּבְרַ֤ךְ עַל בִּרְכָּיו֙ נֶ֚גֶד כָּל קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּפְרֹ֥שׂ כַּפָּ֖יו הַשָּׁמָֽיְמָה

verses.restored: And he said, YHWH, God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth, keeping covenant and showing steadfast love to your servants who walk before you with all their heart.

familiar.text: And said, O LORD God of Israel, there is no God like thee in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto thy servants, that walk before thee with all their hearts:

modern.text: and said: “O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven or on earth, keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.

original.text: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֵין כָּמ֣וֹךָ אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ שֹׁמֵ֤ר הַבְּרִית֙ וְֽהַחֶ֔סֶד לַעֲבָדֶ֕יךָ הַהֹלְכִ֥ים לְפָנֶ֖יךָ בְּכָל לִבָּֽם

verses.restored: You kept with your servant David that which you promised him; you spoke with your mouth and fulfilled it with your hand, as it is this day.

familiar.text: Thou which hast kept with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him; and spakest with thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with thine hand, as it is this day.

modern.text: You have kept Your promise to Your servant, my father David. What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֗רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔י אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ ל֑וֹ וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר בְּפִ֛יךָ וּבְיָדְךָ֥ מִלֵּ֖אתָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Now therefore, YHWH, God of Israel, keep with your servant David my father that which you promised him, saying: There shall not fail you a man before me to sit upon the throne of Israel, so long as your children keep their way, to walk before me in my law, as you walked before me.

familiar.text: Now therefore, O LORD God of Israel, keep with thy servant David my father that which thou hast promised him, saying, There shall not fail thee a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Israel; yet so that thy children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as thou hast walked before me.

modern.text: Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk in My law as you have walked before Me.’

original.text: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁ֠מֹר לְעַבְדְּךָ֨ דָוִ֤יד אָבִי֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֤רְתָּ לּוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹא יִכָּרֵ֨ת לְךָ֥ אִישׁ֙ מִלְּפָנַ֔י יוֹשֵׁ֖ב עַל כִּסֵּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק אִם יִשְׁמְר֨וּ בָנֶ֜יךָ אֶת דַּרְכָּ֗ם לָלֶ֨כֶת֙ בְּת֣וֹרָתִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלַ֖כְתָּ לְפָנָֽי

verses.restored: Now, YHWH, let the word you spoke to your servant David be confirmed.

familiar.text: Now then, O LORD God of Israel, let thy word be verified, which thou hast spoken unto thy servant David.

modern.text: And now, O LORD, God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant David.

original.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֵֽאָמֵן֙ דְּבָ֣רְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ֥ לְדָוִֽיד

verses.restored: But will God indeed dwell with men on the earth? Behold, the heavens and the heaven of heavens cannot contain you, how much less this house that I have built!

familiar.text: But will God in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house which I have built!

notes.title: short
notes.body: Rhetorical question highlighting divine transcendence vs. temple presence.

modern.text: But will God indeed dwell with man upon the earth? Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.

original.text: כִּ֚י הַֽאֻמְנָ֔ם יֵשֵׁ֧ב אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָאָדָ֖ם עַל הָאָ֑רֶץ הִ֠נֵּה שָׁמַ֜יִם וּשְׁמֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכְּל֔וּךָ אַ֕ף כִּֽי הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנִֽיתִי

verses.restored: Therefore attend to the prayer of your servant and to his supplication, O YHWH my God, to hear the cry and the prayer which your servant prays before you.

familiar.text: Have respect therefore to the prayer of thy servant, and to his supplication, O LORD my God, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which thy servant prayeth before thee:

modern.text: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You.

original.text: וּפָנִ֜יתָ אֶל תְּפִלַּ֧ת עַבְדְּךָ֛ וְאֶל תְּחִנָּת֖וֹ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י לִשְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל הָרִנָּה֙ וְאֶל הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַבְדְּךָ֖ מִתְפַּלֵּ֥ל לְפָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Let your eyes be open upon this house day and night, upon the place which you said you would put your name there, to hear the prayer which your servant prays toward this place.

familiar.text: That thine eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof thou hast said that thou wouldest put thy name there; to hearken unto the prayer which thy servant prayeth toward this place.

modern.text: May Your eyes be open toward this temple day and night, toward the place where You said You would put Your Name, so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place.

original.text: לִהְיוֹת֩ עֵינֶ֨יךָ פְתֻח֜וֹת אֶל הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה אֶל הַ֨מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ לָשׂ֥וּם שִׁמְךָ֖ שָׁ֑ם לִשְׁמ֨וֹעַ֙ אֶל הַתְּפִלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתְפַּלֵּ֣ל עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶל הַמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: Hear the supplication of your servant and of your people Israel when they pray toward this place; hear from your dwelling place in heaven, and when you hear, forgive.

familiar.text: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of thy servant, and of thy people Israel, which they shall make toward this place: hear thou from thy dwelling place, even from heaven; and when thou hearest, forgive.

modern.text: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.

original.text: וְשָׁ֨מַעְתָּ֜ אֶל תַּחֲנוּנֵ֤י עַבְדְּךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וּ אֶל הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְ֠אַתָּה תִּשְׁמַ֞ע מִמְּק֤וֹם שִׁבְתְּךָ֙ מִן הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֖ וְסָלָֽחְתָּ

verses.restored: If a man sins against his neighbor and an oath is laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath comes before your altar in this house,

familiar.text: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before thine altar in this house;

modern.text: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,

original.text: אִם יֶחֱטָ֥א אִישׁ֙ לְרֵעֵ֔הוּ וְנָֽשָׁא ב֥וֹ אָלָ֖ה לְהַֽאֲלֹת֑וֹ וּבָ֗א אָלָ֛ה לִפְנֵ֥י מִֽזְבַּחֲךָ֖ בַּבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה

verses.restored: then hear from heaven and act, and judge your servants, returning the wicked to his own way and requiting him on his head, and justifying the righteous by giving him according to his righteousness.

familiar.text: Then hear thou from heaven, and do, and judge thy servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

modern.text: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
